title: Protect Your Home: Reducing Wildfire Risk Starts with Zone 0
description: Beginning in February 2026, the City of San Diego will implement Zone 0, a new California defensible space law. Zone 0 requires property owners to remove combustible materials, including trash, debris, and certain vegetation, within 0 to 5 feet of structures located in the City’s Very High Fire Severity Zones. This area is critical for helping reduce the risk of fires caused by wind-driven embers. Learn more at SanDiego.gov/DefensibleSpace.
